page.notes: Running head "INDEX." set with spaced capitals at the top. Doubtful readings: "sib" at the start of the first line (the first letter looks like a long s or n) [?]; "quæ" in "Actionem habere minus est quæ rem" is hard to read in the scan; "eiusdē" and "cōpetentibus" are partly abbreviated in print; "actlib" and "nasc." at the end of the last entry are cramped and may be misread; the final section numbers of several entries and the "§.1." after "actione" are faint. "Vi", "Vxoriæ" and "vnam" are given as printed in the scan and the u/v rule was applied only where the letter is clearly a vowel or consonant; "Ui" at the start of the second line of the first entry is a case where the printed capital is ambiguous.
